extract.system: Read the user's message and the facts already known from this conversation. Call facts with the user's skill level. Use what the message says when it says it, otherwise the known fact. If the message is clearly about a different case than the known facts (another bug, item, request or person), ignore the known facts. Leave a field empty when neither has it. Never guess.
extract.doc: Finds the user's skill level in the message or in what the conversation already knows.
